description: THE DEFINITIONS DATABASE. One entry per named theorem/concept/term. fis_canon_scan.py auto-merges these with canon_rules.json on every scan: canonical_statement propagates into each folder's .fisnote, regex patterns catch known misstatements, nlp_keywords route matching paragraphs to the :8700 contradiction model with canonical_statement as the hypothesis, and disagreements come back in the 09_TO_REVIEW report. Add an entry = the whole corpus is guarded. Fill statements in over time; status draft = tracked but soft, binding = enforced, retired = ignored.

definitions.canonical_statement: Any CONSISTENT, effectively axiomatized formal system that interprets enough arithmetic cannot prove its own consistency. Self-reference is not the criterion. Godel gives unprovability-from-within, not an external ground.
common_misstatements: any system powerful enough to reference itself
Godel proved the ground must be external

patterns.message: Godel misstated: self-reference given as the criterion.
patterns.next_step: Restate: consistent, effectively axiomatized, interprets enough arithmetic.

definitions.canonical_statement: C = B*log2(1+S/N): non-negative, approaches zero as noise grows, never inverts. Inversion claims need a separately stated mechanism.

patterns.next_step: State a mechanism or soften to capacity-collapse.

definitions.canonical_statement: Every DIFFERENTIABLE (continuous) symmetry of the ACTION corresponds to a conservation law. Not unqualified 'every symmetry'; not discrete symmetries.
common_misstatements: every symmetry gives a conservation law

patterns.next_step: Qualify: continuous symmetry of the action.

definitions.canonical_statement: FILL IN: entropy of an ISOLATED system never decreases; open systems can locally decrease entropy by exporting it.
FILL IN: rules out LOCAL hidden-variable theories; does not prove nonlocal signaling or consciousness effects.
FILL IN: measurement = interaction with a macroscopic apparatus/environment (decoherence); 'observer' does not per se mean a conscious mind in standard QM.
FILL IN: Shannon entropy (information) vs Boltzmann/Gibbs entropy (thermodynamic) - related but not interchangeable; 'disorder' is a heuristic, not the definition.

An isomorphism is a BIJECTIVE structure-preserving map between two structures; it is by definition invertible. A one-directional or 'tridirectional' isomorphism is a category error. One-way structure-preserving = homomorphism; shared property lists without a defined map = correspondence, not isomorphism. Theophysics usage: say 'structural correspondence' or 'property correspondence with a grounding chain' until a formal map is defined.

patterns.message: 'Tridirectional isomorphism' is a category error (isomorphisms are invertible).
patterns.next_step: Rename: tridirectional property correspondence with a one-way grounding chain.
